name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-telemetry-store
description: DESIGN PROTOTYPE (not wired into templates/minimal-site). Persists every polled telemetry read to an append-only CSV under the site's .mdk-data root, serves it back as time-ranged history for a dashboard graph, and reports real, currently-observed storage-transparency stats (mechanism, path, size, row count, growth rate) for the reveal panel. See design/plugin-telemetry-store.md for the CSV-vs-SQLite reasoning and the append-on-read design (Gateway plugins have no interval/boot hook -- see that doc's grounding).

200.description: Freshly pulled telemetry for every device, one CSV row appended per field.

routes.description: Pulls live telemetry (the same devices/fields dashboard.overview reports) and appends one row per field to the CSV store. This route's write only happens when something calls it -- see plugin-telemetry-store.md's 'who calls poll' section for wiring options, since Gateway plugins have no timer/boot hook of their own to drive this on a schedule.

200.description: Oldest-to-newest samples, optionally filtered by device/field/time range, capped at 2000.

routes.description: Pure read: a time-ranged, optionally field-filtered slice of the CSV store, shaped for a dashboard <canvas>/line-chart consumer. No side effects.

200.description: Storage-transparency snapshot: mechanism, file path, size in bytes, row count, and a growth-rate estimate derived from real observed samples.

routes.description: Pure read, no side effects. The response shape here is exactly what design/plugins-fragment.json proposes as SiteReveal.telemetryStorage -- a future sites.reveal implementation would probe this route the same way it already probes /overview for SiteReveal.telemetry.
